color.note: Light theme only (dark mode is post-MVP). Names follow shadcn's CSS variables so `sync-design-system` maps them 1:1 into packages/ui; extra tokens (`*-hover`, `*-subtle`, `success`, `warning-*`) are Cuadre's own.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and main content background. Ground for `foreground` (19.8:1), `muted-foreground` (5.74:1), `primary` text (6.62:1).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted`, `secondary`, `accent`, `sidebar` and `primary-subtle` (all ≥ 17:1).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Bordered panels (form section, table frame). Same value as `background`; separated by `border`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Select/Combobox listbox, dropdown menus, dialog surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: THE accent (petrol teal). Primary button fill, links, active nav indicator, selected checkbox. As text on `background` 6.62:1, on `muted` 6.07:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the primary button. `primary-foreground` on it 8.45:1.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (6.62:1) and `primary-hover` (8.45:1).

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active nav item ground, info callouts. Never used as the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: primary-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary-subtle` (7.36:1), e.g. the active nav item label.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, neutral badge (Borrador) ground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (16.4:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Table header row, read-only input, skeleton blocks, code chips.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table headers, help text, placeholders, captions. On `background` 5.74:1, on `muted` 5.27:1, on `sidebar` 5.50:1. Changed from shadcn's #737373 (4.35:1 on `muted`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn's hover surface (ghost button hover, menu item highlight, table row hover). NOT the brand accent: that is `primary`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (16.4:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, invalid input border, error text on `background` (6.47:1).

tokens.name: destructive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the destructive button.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `destructive` (6.47:1) and `destructive-hover`.

tokens.name: destructive-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of error alerts (form-level and table-level errors).

tokens.name: destructive-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `destructive-subtle` (7.6:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text on `background` (5.02:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the Emitido badge and success alerts.

tokens.name: success-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `success-subtle` (6.81:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon and outline on `background` (4.84:1) and on `warning-subtle`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of warnings (e.g. missing BCV rate for today).

tokens.name: warning-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `warning-subtle` (6.84:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers: table row lines, card outlines, header and sidebar edges. Decorative only (1.26:1); never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects, combobox triggers, checkboxes and outline buttons. 3.69:1 on `background`, 3.54:1 on `sidebar` (WCAG 1.4.11). Darker than shadcn's (#e5e5e5).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in `background`. 6.62:1 on `background`, 6.07:1 on `muted`, 6.34:1 on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the confirm dialog.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav item text on `sidebar` (19.0:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active nav indicator bar (3px) and the Cuadre wordmark. 6.34:1 on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary` fills.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Nav item hover ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar right edge and footer divider (decorative).

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar (same as `ring`).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One h1 per page, in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Precio de venta en dólares, sin IVA.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav items, button labels.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells (32px rows). Numbers use tabular-nums.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column headers, in `muted-foreground`, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text, error text, pagination, badges, sidebar section headings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, label-to-control gap, table cell horizontal padding (with space-3 at edges).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, nav item padding, first/last table cell inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, toolbar-to-table gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page content padding, gap between form sections, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page blocks.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. Every pointer target is at least `target-min` (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, combobox triggers (shadcn h-8).

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: table-row-height
tokens.usage: Body row height of DataTable; header row is the same.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header; also the scroll-padding-top so focused elements are never hidden under it.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed sidebar width (desktop only, not collapsible in the MVP). Fits the longest nav label, "Recepciones de mercancía", on one line.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target (2.5.8, AA). Icon buttons are 32×32 or 28×28.

tokens.name: search-width
tokens.usage: Search input in table toolbars.

tokens.name: form-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a page form (2 columns of fields).

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Confirm dialog width.

tokens.name: viewport-min
tokens.usage: Minimum supported viewport width. Below it the page scrolls horizontally.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, table frame. Maps to shadcn's `--radius`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Select and Combobox listboxes, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Confirm dialog. The overlay behind it is rgba(10,10,10,0.5).
